description_en: Creates a database account for an ApsaraDB for ClickHouse cluster
description_zh: 调用CreateAccount接口为指定云数据库ClickHouse集群创建数据库账号
kebab_example: aliyun clickhouse create-account --db-cluster-id cc-bp108z124a8o70000 --account-name test --account-password '123789Ff!' --account-description ceshi --api-version 2019-11-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAccount

parameters.description_en:
The name of the database account.

> 

*   The name must be unique in the cluster.

*   The name can contain lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (\_).
*   The name must start with a lowercase letter and end with a lowercase letter or a digit.
*   The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length.
parameters.description_zh:
数据库账号。
>- 名称唯一。
- 由小写字母、数字或下划线组成。
- 以小写字母开头，以小写字母或数字结尾。
- 长度为2~64个字符。

parameters.description_en:
The password of the database account.

> 

*   The password must contain at least three types of the following characters: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.

*   The password can contain the following special characters: ! @ # $ % ^ & \* ( ) \_ + - =
*   The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length.
parameters.description_zh:
数据库账号的密码。
>- 由大写字母、小写字母、数字、特殊字符中的任意三种组成。
- 特殊字符为!@#$%^&*()_+-=
- 长度为8~32个字符。

parameters.description_en:
The description of the database account.

> 

*   The description cannot start with http:// or https://.

*   The description must be 0 to 256 characters in length.
parameters.description_zh:

>- 不能以http://或https://开头。
- 长度为0~256个字符。
